deviations_from_brief: The repository is assembled at /tmp/wnn_repo rather than /kaggle/working/repo so that only small outputs land in /kaggle/working/out.

The fit is the E511 C1 fold-0 argv (init c20261003_combo_s3_f0@ep3, valid-fold 0, train+valid) minus the --distill teacher-prediction arguments, because the fold-0 teacher prediction files (pred_c20261003_combo_s{3,4}_f0_train.npy, 1.7 GB each) are not in any private dataset; plus --max-batches 30.

The H230 distill cache (vladkochetov07/h230-seed9-parent-source-cache-v2) was not mounted: its metadata is all-data membership (no fold-0 split) and the family-target files it needs (families_*.npy, about 8 GB) are absent.
